provenance.native_cmd: jl_tree_k --L 2000 --out <file> (all suites; the default suite list)
provenance.status: computed (native C++), agreeing with the Python stage-02/03 values where compared; the Ihara torsion and W_D are NEW (computed; W_D agrees with PARI mfatkininit traces, the Ihara free rank with PARI mfdim)

conventions.coefficients: Sym^{k-2}, (g.P)(X,Y) = P((X,Y)g), columns = images of X^{n-t}Y^t (twoterm.sym = [C] def:rhon); interim local model at p (TreeK.h): iota_p = right multiplication on e O/p^m, frames a_c with I_c (x) Z_p = O_p a_c
conventions.ihara_map: iota(f0, f1) = s_0^* f0 - s_1^* f1 (amalgam.py MV sign alpha(x,y) = dg_1 x - dg_q y); (s_j^* f)(e) = u_j^{-1} f(s_j e); u_0 = phi_c(gamma_0), u_1 = iota(a_{c'} gamma_1 g a_c^{-1}), g = mu/(q N_{c'}) (transport as amalgam.py's kappa: the second vertex group is moved back along the edge)
conventions.weights: W_H = W^H = e_H W (|H| a unit for l >= 5); the cohomological H_0 uses the traces [H_x:H_e] (ihara.py), the homological e_H u_j (twoterm.py); |Gamma_x| includes -1
conventions.W_D: BrandtSym.h (C4)/(C5): Pi_D unnormalised (Pi_D^2 = D^n); reported W_D = Pi_D / D^{n/2}
conventions.flag: no convention was ambiguous for the compared cells (all match); the l <= k torsion lies outside Task 2's range and is reported separately

scan.statement: for each scanned l the l-primary torsion is decided exactly (rank drop mod l, then the elementary divisors mod l^m, l^m < 10^12); unscanned primes are not covered

ihara_NEW.lattice: the polynomial lattice Sym^n(Z_l^2) of twoterm.sym ((g.P)(X,Y) = P((X,Y)g)), which agrees with BrandtSym's Lambda_c at l !| D; the l <= k torsion depends on this choice (divided powers or the dual can differ)
ihara_NEW.observation_l_le_k_lattice: polynomial lattice Sym^n(Z_l^2) (twoterm.sym = BrandtSym Lambda_c at l !| D)
ihara_NEW.observation_l_le_k: every torsion prime l <= k found has (l + 1) | (k - 2), exponent 1

ihara_exact_NEW.lattice_convention: BrandtSym (HJ-4a) intrinsic Lambda_c on every vertex and edge cell: Sym^n(Z_l^2) at every l !| D (seed convention, l = 2, 3 included), the (O^0)^# choice at l | D; vertex module Lambda_c^{Gamma_c}, edge module Lambda_c^{Gamma_e} (c = class of the edge representative); Gross form, (s_0^* f)(e) = rho(gamma_0^{-1}) f, (s_1^* f)(e) = rho(beta^{-1}) f, beta^{-1} = conj(mu) x_1 / (N_c N_c'); iota = (s_0^*, -s_1^*). The s_1^* block needed no q-scaling (a = 0 in every cell), but the q-part is still not an invariant of the S-arithmetic group (V is not q-integral) and is reported apart.

pari_mfatkininit_check.relation: tr W_D = [k = 2] - tr(w_D | S_k(D)^new) (PARI mfatkininit, C = 1); rank = dim S_k(D)^new + [k = 2]
